title: Altimmune to Participate in the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Altimmune's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.altimmune.com/node/17981/pdf)


GAITHERSBURG, Md., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Altimmune, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qHHlDF8IipxlVXOF1S-6_XF8BG_HstdVks3PYud3Dt12HJOlTqPDfkgnt-U65zVy2_Of-tjWle6r7wSrJQ1Wrw==) (Nasdaq: ALT), a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing pemvidutide to address serious liver diseases, today announced that management will participate in a fireside chat at the Wells Fargo 21st Annual Healthcare Conference on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. ET.


A webcast of the fireside chat will be available via the[Events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=px2Ii0Ac1OFoxiFkZpf26yYqR_o6Ay32Gj8MoAKjZrSPEXLqcTMrK2Mi8UdaHd9kr3SX8OyOUls_N2zBRfwh0uIKDsMT2gYo_lZAZ5NVTkS_5AWWMSkADE0Hm-NbuW2CnfyGTdqRCT0P23BeqsrFJR0dnH8mWl7zyzXqpp8_QkwKaZqApMeForUcEZG674vzFSmYqBBlht6En85d-aDsYC9NQBMo_W2VSwgxZilNqtPR4GceuEQeoQpJnvPy3pcCNFI25w8MwugdQjPQVdkfw4Z5bonmANRsCJyOe3O7Quk4_l1RKSvIoNaTPFVQpn7y) section of the Altimmune website.


**About Altimmune**
Altimmune is a late clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for patients with serious liver diseases. The Company’s lead candidate, pemvidutide, is a unique dual-action investigational therapy targeting both glucagon and GLP-1 receptors in a balanced 1:1 ratio in development for the treatment of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), alcohol use disorder (AUD) and alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD).
